title: Well Hello Securitas
desc: Hello there! You clicked through to this page, I appreciate that. My unsubtle advert on LinkedIn caught your eye. This is an open letter to you dear Securitas...
html:
Well Hello There Securitas!

You found this page. That means my cunning plan has worked. You clicked on my very unsubtle LinkedIn advert and here you are. I’ve hooked you in.

I know it was a bit cheeky, but I wanted to grab your attention. You see, Securitas is a company I really want to work with. And no, I don’t say that to all the companies.

And no, I don’t say that to ALL the companies.

I work at a digital studio right here in Gothenburg, and we're a little particular about the people and companies we partner with. We’re proud to have worked with some of the outstanding Swedish companies. And we want to work with you too.

So let's grab a cup of tea, and let me explain why we’re a good match...

Russell Clark
Business Director, Humblebee
russell.clark@humblebee.se

Why I like Securitas.

Many reasons. From the outside looking in, you appear to be pioneering AI in security applications. Not to mention prioritising environmental responsibility.

AI Smartness

You seem to be integrating AI and machine learning into your security offerings to enhance threat detection, automate security tasks, and improve risk assessment.

Sustainability

You're committed to sustainability, promoting environmentally friendly practices, reducing your carbon footprint, and ensuring ethical and responsible operations.

Technology Focus

You're actively integrating technology into your security solutions, investing in AI, machine learning, and data analytics to enhance threat detection and automate tasks.

Whether optimising AI for risk prediction, or reducing your environmental impact through initiatives like green vehicle fleets, your commitment to innovation and sustainability is remarkable.

Security Trends in 2025

Humblebee understand the security services landscape. We can help you stay ahead of the curve.

Technology

The security industry is rapidly adopting new technologies, such as AI, machine learning, and cloud-based solutions, to enhance security measures and improve efficiency. This includes AI-powered video analytics & facial recognition.

Integrated solutions

Customers are increasingly seeking integrated solutions that combine physical security with electronic systems, remote monitoring, and data analytics. This trend is driven by the need for more comprehensive and pro-active security measures.

Cybersecurity

With the increasing frequency and sophistication of cyberattacks, cybersecurity and data protection are becoming paramount concerns. This includes the adoption of zero-trust architecture and the development of quantum encryption techniques.

AI

AI and machine learning are being used to enhance threat detection, automate security tasks, and improve risk assessment. AI-powered systems can analyse vast amounts of data to identify patterns and anomalies, enabling more proactive and intelligent security measures.

Cloud based systems

Cloud-based systems offer scalability, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness, driving their adoption in the security industry. Cloud-based solutions also enable real-time updates and remote access, enhancing security management and response capabilities.

Sustainability

The security industry is increasingly focused on minimising its environmental impact and promoting sustainable practices. This includes adopting energy-efficient technologies, reducing waste, and promoting responsible sourcing of materials.

Let us make you a hero.

Working with us is good for your career. We help our friends and partners shine. Any digital project you're leading, we'll make sure it's a success.

Lead Your Industry

We build outstanding digital products that put your business ahead. Our job is to help you lead, not follow.

Value from Day One

Our team knows your industry. Designers, developers, and strategists hit the ground running, no hand-holding required.

Grow with our network

Join our community of ambitious leaders. We open doors, share knowledge, and help you level up professionally.

We’re ridiculously passionate about helping world class Swedish companies like Securitas stay on top. Why? Because we believe strong, responsible businesses today create a better future for the generations of Swedish workers to come.

Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom.

I like what you folks are doing, and I think a partnership with us could add value to your company. If you've read this far down the page I appreciate your interest, and hope to hear from you. Cheers!
